Messages.Author: salem christ
Messages.Body:
LSJ <vte...@white-wolf.com> wrote in message news:<3B694A57...@white-wolf.com>...

> Garou wrote:
> > 2-Can you burn a blood to a Vamp that doens't have blood? Then , What
> > happen?? ---> goes to torpor???
>
> You could burn an empty vampire with the appropriate effect (say, 2 agg
> damage), sure. A burned vampire doesn't go to torpor.

or, perhaps, the question he meant to ask was:
"can you burn a blood on a vampire that doesn't have any blood?"

to which i would reply:
a vampire will never go to torpor from "burn blood" effects, even if
they have no blood. (this gets slightly murky during non-agg damage
resolution, as an empty vampire taking one damage will go to torpor.
however, it wasn't because he "tried to burn a blood and failed", it's
because he has an unhealed point of damage to resolve.)
as for "can you burn a blood" on an empty vamp: yes. it just does
nothing.
however, this doesn't quite work if you want to burn the blood to "do"
something, or to pay for something.
example: aisha's card text of "burn one blood to get +1 intercept". if
she is empty, she can't get the intercept. she needs to burn the blood
to "do" the thing.
example: smiling jack the anarch says "burn one blood or pool for each
counter on jack" [paraphrased]. you can't just choose an empty vampire
an say "that vampire burns blood for each counter on jack".
example: forced awakening has text of "burn one blood if this vampire
fails to block the action" [paraphrased again]. this is a side-effect
of failing to block. kind of a "passive" effect. if the vampire is
empty, it just tries and fails to burn the one blood.

there, now if that doesn't confuse you, i'll be suprised.

salem.
